thread:
Ana H: Hey all — first week question. Who owns what when a production inference request is failing with 504s? Trying to map who to ping for: routing/fallbacks, model variant rollbacks, infra (GPU/hosts), and billing contact for Dedicated customers. Also, any quick escalation path if it looks like a capacity issue?

Devon B: Welcome Ana! :wave: Short answer: infra handles host/GPU / SRE handles platform; runtime team owns routing and fallback logic; eng-platform handles Dedicated config + billing handoff. But here's a quick matrix I use: 

```
- infra: node/GPU health, host-level ops
- eng-sre: alerts, oncall rotations, incident exec
- eng-runtime: model routing, KV cache, fallback policies
- eng-platform: Dedicated capacity, billing + contracts
- devex: access, SDK onboarding
```

Devon B: If it's a 504 at the load balancer -> ping infra + eng-sre. If it's degraded model quality or wrong variant -> eng-runtime + research. If it's capacity for a Dedicated customer -> eng-platform + sales/ops.

Jess: Adding access notes: request Dedicated/billing access via Okta group 'dedicated-admins' and CC eng-platform. If you need to escalate outage, use #release-war-room and @oncall-bot escalate to page the oncall rotation.

Maya: For ramping up, read the shorter playbook here: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/ownership-map — it shows primary/secondary owners and a one-line escalate step for each failure type.

Ana H: Thanks — is there a quick command to check which model variant is currently routed for a customer?

Devon B: Yep — use the infra-safe CLI: 
```
redwoodctl route get --customer <cust-id> --env prod
# shows model, variant, routing_policy, pinned_version
```

Jess: Also FYI: for urgent infra paging do `@oncall-bot page infra` in the channel or run `ops/incident start` in the CLI. Non-urgent billing issues go to eng-platform-saas@redwood.com.

Maya: If you want, I can drop a one-pager in the onboarding doc with the matrix and the three common escalation flows (LB 504s, model regressions, Dedicated capacity).

Ana H: That would be awesome, thanks Maya. One last: who owns model onboarding (getting a new open model into the catalog)?

Devon B: eng-runtime + eng-ml jointly own model onboarding. eng-ml handles evals/quality checks, eng-runtime handles serving/quantization profiles. For turnkey onboarding, ping #eng-ml and add the "model-onboard" label in the PR.

oncall-bot: NOTE: If a page is sent, please include request-id and sample payload to speed debugging.

Ana H: Great — I think I can follow this. I'll add a checklist to my onboarding notes and loop Maya for the one-pager. :thumbsup:
